summary: Loads texture map images referenced by an FBX COMP or USD COMP import parent.

key_params.name: parent
key_params.note: FBX COMP or USD COMP import parent

key_params.name: texture
key_params.note: Path to texture image within imported asset context

common_gotchas: A missing or wrong import parent means the texture path cannot be resolved.
Blank Parent performs implicit import-parent search, which can select an unexpected ancestor.
External texture file paths must remain valid after asset moves.
Reload after replacing imported assets; Import Select does not create missing maps.
key_concepts: Import Select TOP selects texture images defined by imported FBX COMP or USD COMP assets.
Imported maps can include color, normal, metallic, and other material texture images.
Texture image data may be embedded in the source asset, such as USDZ, or stored externally by path.
Parent points to the import parent, and blank Parent searches for the first import parent in the path.
Texture is a path to the texture image inside the import context.
Reload refreshes image data from the import parent.
